name: accessibility-mcp-demo
description: Ask Claude to check a public web page for common accessibility problems and get a plain-English answer.
long_description: A small demo of a custom Claude connector. Give Claude a public web page address and it runs ten basic checks (seven WCAG 2.1 A/AA criteria and three best practices), then explains what is wrong, why it matters to real people and how to fix it, worst problems first. Automated checks flag likely problems; they cannot prove a page is accessible and the results are not evidence of legal compliance. The connector only reads public http and https pages, stores nothing and needs no account.

tools.name: scan_page
tools.description: Check one public web page for common accessibility problems and return a plain-English report.
